events_seen: CUT (Jul 29 (today)): Corbishley released Roschon Johnson (RB, CHI).
CUT (Jul 29 (today)): Kevin released Zach Ertz (TE, FA).

TRADE (Jul 29 (today)): Corbishley receives Chris Bell (WR, MIA), David Montgomery (RB, HOU), Joe Burrow (QB, CIN), Jordan Addison (WR, MIN). Kevin receives Michael Wilson (WR, ARI), Quinshon Judkins (RB, CLE), Daniel Jones (QB, IND), Christian Watson (WR, GB), 2027 R2 pick.
CUT (Jul 29 (today)): Kevin released Marquez Valdes-Scantling (WR, DAL).
CUT (Jul 29 (today)): Kevin released Raheem Mostert (RB, FA).
CUT (Jul 29 (today)): Kevin released Adam Thielen (WR, FA).

TRADE (Jul 19 (10 days ago)): Corbishley receives Michael Wilson (WR, ARI), Tee Higgins (WR, CIN), Breece Hall (RB, NYJ), 2027 R2 pick. Fronge receives TreVeyon Henderson (RB, NE), Kyle Monangai (RB, CHI), Nico Collins (WR, HOU), 2028 R2 pick.
TRADE (Jul 17 (12 days ago)): Adam receives Justin Herbert (QB, LAC). Fronge receives Jacory Croskey-Merritt (RB, WAS), C.J. Stroud (QB, HOU), 2028 R1 pick.
TRADE (Jul 10 (19 days ago)): Adam receives Keaton Mitchell (RB, LAC). Wingard receives 2028 R3 pick.
WAIVER CLAIM (Jun 21 (38 days ago)): Drew added Colbie Young (WR, CIN) (dropped Joe Mixon (RB, FA)).

tweets.name: Dina Ravioli
tweets.text: The Corbishley-Kevin trade is bigger than it looks on paper. I'm told the Burrow piece was Kevin's primary ask from the jump — Jones and Judkins were the framework that made the math close. Daniel Jones as a QB2 in a superflex format is not nothing, but Burrow as a QB1 is a different business entirely. Apex got their guy. The question is at what cost.

tweets.name: Marty Volkman
tweets.text: I'm hearing — and this is early, so hold loosely — that Kevin's decision to cut Ertz, MVS, Mostert, and Thielen in the same window as filing this trade was not coincidental. A source I trust slightly more than usual describes it as 'clearing the deck with intention.' Redline at $84.67 and apparently not done moving.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: Kevin released Zach Ertz. Raheem Mostert. Adam Thielen. Marquez Valdes-Scantling. All today. All in a window where he also traded away Burrow. I want to be careful here because I have been wrong about Redline before — but I need someone to explain to me what the 2026 roster looks like right now, because from where I'm standing it looks like a skeleton in a blazer.

tweets.name: Big Dog
tweets.text: Corbishley now has Tee Higgins, Breece Hall, Michael Wilson, Jordan Addison, Chris Bell, David Montgomery, AND Joe Burrow. In ten days. I don't know what to tell you. The Guiness Guzzlers front office woke up and chose VIOLENCE.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: Everyone acting shocked that Kevin stripped the roster post-trade should go back and look at what he inherited from the Wes situation. He has been rebuilding with distressed assets because that is literally what Redline Distressed Capital does. The cuts today aren't panic — they're the business model. I've been saying Redline was a slow buy for two months. The 24% pop to $84.67 was the tell.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: Quinshon Judkins landing at Redline after the Corbishley trade is the most underreacted-to piece of this entire transaction log today. Young back, cheap contract, CLE offense that will need to run the ball. I am not screaming about this one. I'm saying it quietly, which means I'm more sure than usual: that asset has a ceiling Kevin did not pay for.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: The Roschon Johnson cut from Apex makes complete sense once you understand what Corbishley is building at RB — Hall and Montgomery in the same room means the depth chart math changed overnight. You don't carry Johnson behind that. The move that looks like housekeeping is actually just good roster construction.

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Tonight's Exchange Report: the Corbishley-Kevin blockbuster, four Redline cuts in a single afternoon, and what the Apex stock dip to $103.98 is actually telling us about how the market reads 16-trade GMs who still don't have QB certainty. Terrence and Dexter are already on opposite sides of this. We're live at seven.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: The Redline roster after today's cuts and that trade is a lot of question marks and a lot of runway — which, honestly, is not the worst thing in a league where the 2027 class is being treated like a golden ticket. Kevin has Judkins, Wilson, Watson, Jones, and a 2027 second. That's not a championship roster. It might be a very good 2027 foundation, and I think that's the pitch.
